candidates.requirement: Exercise compilation of a pattern containing (?C) with PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT set in the compile context.
candidates.target_route: The fuzzer already passes input-derived patterns and a compile context to pcre2_compile. Setting the supported extra option on that context before the same compile call would reach the changed rejection branch.
candidates.failure_condition: The context retains its default extra_options value of zero, so no fuzz input can make the NEVER_CALLOUT guard true or exercise acceptance of that extra option by the compile-option mask.
candidates.alternative_paths: A pattern can supply (?C), but neither the pattern-start options nor the tracked inline extra options set NEVER_CALLOUT. The harness's match callout is configured in a different context after compilation and is not an equivalent route.
